notes: Parser-resilience sanity-check for muse: a single bash tool call (python3 -c "print('x'*200000)") generates a ~200,000-character blob that lands FULLY inline (no elision) in one tool_result_batch_committed line's results[].text (parser.go parseToolResultBatchCommitted has no truncation logic — confirmed against a real ls -la tool_result line on this machine, 12,729 untruncated bytes). muse is a single-birth FilesUnderRoot+JSONLineParser adapter (agent.go), so it runs over the SAME shared core/pkg/tailer (readLineCapped, maxTranscriptLineSize=64MB, issue #270): below the cap a line parses normally; at/above it the line is logged-and-skipped past, never truncated into a partial record and never wedging subsequent lines. The largest line ever organically observed in this machine's local corpus (237 session.jsonl files, 27,231 lines, python3 scan) is 123,761 bytes — so this ~200KB recipe line, while itself still a sanity-check well under the 64MB cap (genuine cap-stress is pinned agent-agnostically by core/pkg/tailer/large_line_test.go, not by any live CLI recording), is already larger than anything muse has organically produced here. turn_start/turn_end are pinned same_session_as:session_birth because muse spawns goal-reminder/verify-reminder subagents on every prompt that skip the ready birth and go straight to working (format-spec §9) — an unpinned matcher can vacuously bind to a subagent's own arc instead of the parent's, exactly as the sibling 2-2_auto-executed-tool-call cell's live recording exposed and fixed. No teardown/process_exited phase is asserted, mirroring 2-13_turn-end-terminal-text's precedent, because the OPEN #1962 processlifecycle race can misattribute process_exited to a reminder-subagent's late PID re-registration. VACUOUS-PASS CAVEAT: the recipe's bash command is a single unchained invocation (no && or for), chosen because this corpus's own 2-2 cell shows a plain ls -la is policy-fast-tracked (policy_decision:'allow:policy') while chained shell commands recorded elsewhere on this machine were routed through muse's kind:'approval' LLM-judge review instead — if THIS command shape is ever routed through that review, the recording drifts into testing 2-17_user-blocking-question's path instead of this one; that is UNVERIFIED until a live recording confirms no waiting detour occurs.

text: Session appears in ready shortly after the muse TUI finishes launching (single-birth: session id = the session directory basename)

User prompt drives ready → working on the SAME session born ready (run.started → EventType=user_message); goal-reminder/verify-reminder subagents skip the ready birth entirely so this filter excludes them

The ~200KB tool_result_batch_committed line is parsed (or, if ever above the 64MB cap, skipped-and-logged) without stalling; run.terminal:completed → turn_done → working → ready. Completion of this transition is the parser-resilience proof — if the tailer had wedged on the oversized line it would never fire.
